name: Westrock Coffee - Concord NC Roasting & Extract Campus (S&D legacy)

fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or sliding gate found at the truck entrance off the campus drive. The truck yard is reached by a curved private campus drive from Concord Parkway South; satellite shows wide open paved aprons and no checkpoint pinch-point. Some campus drives off Concord Pkwy could not be Street-Viewed at the actual yard entrance (2017/2026 panos cover the highway frontage and the across-road dealership side), so this is marked uncertain — but no gate structure is visible in overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the yard entrance or along the campus drive.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Long dock apron on the NE face of the north building shows ~14 trailer/dock positions in the close-up, plus additional bays around the building cluster — ~22 estimated site-wide. Multi-building campus makes an exact total hard to confirm.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of ~4 connected/adjacent large buildings — the legacy S&D Coffee & Tea main roasting-and-extract complex.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailers parked in a yard area NW of the dock apron, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved yard aprons and ample maneuvering width — physical room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located on Concord Parkway South, a busy multi-lane signalized arterial within the Charlotte-metro fabric (apartments, big-box retail, dealerships adjacent) — Urban.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard between the campus entrance and the dock doors gives interior holding room.
